lina: quick accessibility sweep request — the new model-playground panel (right rail) is shipping tomorrow, can folks sanity-check keyboard landmarks & screen-reader hints? screenshot: https://img.redwood.ai/UX/rail-v3.png devon: on it. quick note: while tabbing I see focus hit the toggle group, then it jumps into the card header links before the controls. feels like inconsistent DOM order. samir: same here on NVDA+Firefox — when focus lands on the param sliders NVDA reads 'slider' but then announces the label only after you adjust it. suspect missing aria-labelledby on the input wrapper. zoe: probably because sliders are custom div-based controls. can we switch to native for keyboard/sr, and style that? small snippet: ``` ``` mike: +1 to native inputs for lower maintenance. also contrast: the slider thumb uses token `--muted-4` on dark which is 3.8:1 against track — fails WCAG AA for non-text interactive elements. Suggest `--accent-6`. olivia: another spot: the right-rail container isn't marked as a landmark region. Screen reader users need a predictable landmark to jump to. propose adding `role="region" aria-label="Model controls"` to the panel wrapper. Example: `
` lina: agree. also thinking a skip link would help keyboard users who land on the rail from a deep link. something like: `Skip to main` — we already have `.sr-skip` utility in global styles. samir: small NVDA quirk: if a region has `tabindex="0"` NVDA sometimes duplicates the region name on focus. we should avoid `tabindex="0"` on the region wrapper unless it needs programmatic focus. use focusable controls only. devon: noted. for the toolbar buttons inside the panel, can we add `aria-pressed` states for toggle buttons? currently we rely on CSS class only, SR doesn't get state. zoe: sample markup for toggles: `` then update aria-pressed on toggle. mike: ran `axe` locally — two violations: color-contrast for placeholder text in search (1.9:1) and duplicate id on the quick-help tooltip. ticket please? lina: created tickets: UX-1423 (slider contrast), UX-1424 (region landmarks + skip link), UX-1425 (toggle aria-pressed), UX-1426 (duplicate id cleanup). Linking in PR when ready. aria-bot: automated test: ran `a11y-scan` on branch `rail-v3` — found 4 new issues, grouped in UX-1423..1426. Full report: https://ci.redwood.ai/a11y/rails/1725001234 olivia: tiny copy nit: the tooltip says "Model params" but NVDA reads it as "tooltip, Model params, collapsed" — consider `aria-roledescription="panel"`? might be overkill. maybe change to "Parameters" so SR users hear a clearer label. samir: prefer changing label to `Parameters` + `aria-describedby` for the short hint text. avoids adding extra roles. devon: implementation plan: 1) replace custom sliders with native ranges where feasible, 2) add `role=region aria-label="Model controls"`, 3) add skip link, 4) fix contrast tokens + duplicate id. I'll open a PR and tag y'all for reviews. lina: timeline OK? we need this for tomorrow's canary at 2pm. mike: can do the contrast and id fixes today. range migration might need review but can be behind a flag if we need to ship. zoe: happy to review the markup this afternoon. olivia: I'll update microcopy in the tooltip PR. samir: when PR is up, can someone run a quick NVDA pass on Windows? I'll run VoiceOver on mac. devon: will do NVDA pass. tagging @lina for visibility. :thumbsup:
